verses.1: And Jacob raised his eyes, and he saw that Esau was coming with four thousand men. He took the children from Leah and Rachel, as well as from the two maids.
verses.2: And he placed his servants and their children on one side, Leah and her children on another side, and Rachel and Joseph on yet another side.
verses.3: And he passed by them, and they bowed down to the ground seven times, until he reached his brothers.
verses.4: And Esau ran to listen to his voice. Then he hugged him, and fell on his face. He wept.
verses.5: And he raised his eyes and saw the women and the children. He said, “Who are these to you?” And the children replied, “These are the children that God has chosen as His servants.”
verses.6: And the women rushed forward, along with their children, and they bowed down in reverence.
verses.7: And Leah also went to her children, and they bowed down in worship. After that, Joseph and Rachel also went to their children and bowed down in worship.
verses.8: And he said, “Who is it that has given you all this wealth that I’ve found?” And he said, “It’s someone who deserves to be honored in the eyes of Adonai.”
verses.9: And Esau said, “I have plenty. My brother, it will be yours when you go.”
verses.10: And Jacob said, “Please, may I be accepted by you? May you accept my offering from me. For that reason, I saw your face as if it were the face of God. You liked me.”
verses.11: Please take my blessing, which has been given to you. For God has blessed me, and I have everything. He has taken it from me.
verses.12: And he said, “Let us go and walk away from you.”
verses.13: And he said to him, “My Lord, you know that the children are delicate and fragile. In the morning, they become stronger, but one day they will die, along with all the lambs.”
verses.14: Please, my Lord, let me go before my servant. I will carry out the tasks that lie ahead of me, as well as those related to the children. Then I will come back to my Lord in the city.
verses.15: And Esau said, “Please show me those people who are with me.” Then he asked, “Why does this find please the eyes of my master?”
verses.16: And on that day, Esau went back to his own path.
verses.17: And Jacob traveled along the path, and he built a house for himself. To mark this place, he built a structure there. Therefore, that place was named Sukkot.
verses.18: And Jacob came to Shechem, a city that was located in the land of Canaan. He arrived from Paddan Aram. He stood at the entrance of the city.
verses.19: And he built the part of the field where his tent was located. It was a place that the sons of Hamor, father of Shechem, had set up there, at a distance of one hundred cubits.
verses.20: And he set up a sacrifice there, and called out to the God of Israel.
